tasks.label: Descargar componentes desde Markdown
tasks.command: $mdPath = '.vscode/setup.md'; if (-not (Test-Path $mdPath)) { Write-Error 'No se encontró el archivo de configuración setup.md'; exit 1 }; $content = Get-Content $mdPath -Raw; $downloads = @(); if ($content -match '- \[x\].*\.github/agents') { $downloads += @{Source='.github/agents'; Destination='.github/agents'; Strip=2} }; if ($content -match '- \[x\].*\.github/skills') { $downloads += @{Source='skills'; Destination='.github/skills'; Strip=1} }; if ($content -match '- \[x\].*README\.md') { $downloads += @{Source='README.md'; Destination='.'; Strip=0} }; if ($downloads.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No hay elementos seleccionados con [x] en el archivo Markdown.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 }; git fetch https://github.com/aimarsanm/python-unit-test-agents.git main --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; foreach ($download in $downloads) { $source=$download.Source; $destination=$download.Destination; $strip=$download.Strip; if ($destination -ne '.') { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination -Force | Out-Null }; $treePath='FETCH_HEAD:' + $source; git cat-file -e $treePath; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error ('La ruta ' + $source + ' no existe en el repositorio remoto.'); exit 1 }; git archive FETCH_HEAD -- $source | tar -x --strip-components=$strip -C $destination }; Write-Host '¡Descarga completada con éxito!' -ForegroundColor Green
